VoiceMailGreeting2.name: VoiceMailGreeting2
VoiceMailGreeting2.description: Represents information about a voicemail message that reps can drop during outbound customer calls, or set to play when they're unable to take calls from customers.

DurationInSeconds.description: The duration of the voicemail message in seconds.

GreetingUrl.description: The URL of the audio file for the voicemail message.

Name.description: The name of the voicemail message.

OwnerId.description: ID of the voicemail message owner.

ReferenceGreetingResourceId.description: ID of the content document that contains the voicemail message.

Type.description: The type of voicemail message. Possible values are: Greeting VoicemailDrop
